evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Je komt terecht in een gedreven en ondernemende organisatie waar de beslissingslijnen kort zijn
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Entrepreneurial, short-decision-line framing dominates with no explicit rigour/quality-governance language, but the A-to-Z consultancy delivery model (engineering, analysis, science, governance) tempers a pure velocity read, so mixed.
evidence.domain_risk: Dit projecthuis kent een zeer sterke ondernemerscultuur... helpen ze klanten om data driven te worden
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: A generalist data consultancy building client data solutions with no financial, regulatory, or compliance language anywhere in the JD.
evidence.collaboration_width: de data scientist; de BI specialisten; de business profielen
evidence.data_team_maturity: het team van het projecthuis zelf, dat meer dan 100 leden telt
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A 100+ member consultancy team with distinct specialisms (data science, BI, engineering) implies an established, growing function rather than a from-zero build.
evidence.jd_authorship: Je vertaalt de noden van klanten naar data-oplossingen door nauw samen te werken met de data scientist, de BI specialisten en de business profielen
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Generic client-facing consultancy language with no precise tool-in-context or volume/scale detail — reads as recruiter-style boilerplate.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: de data scientist, de BI specialisten en de business profielen
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Work is oriented around the internal project team and its specialists (data science, BI) delivering to client business stakeholders — internal_data framing.
evidence.autonomy_level: Je zit samen met de business om hun noden in kaart te brengen en samen te brainstormen naar een oplossing
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Collaborative, support-oriented verbs (samen brainstormen, ontwikkel je in samenwerking) with no strategic ownership language — execution.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tooling or AI-adjacent responsibility mentioned anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: No testing, data quality, or observability language anywhere in the JD.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: No risk, compliance, or reliability register present — purely delivery/capability framed.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Vervolgens ontwikkel je in samenwerking met jouw team en de klant datamodellen die passen bij hun business noden
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Building new client-specific data models within ongoing consultancy engagements — mixed greenfield-within-delivery framing.
evidence.language_gate: Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en/of Frans met een goede kennis van het Engels
